outcome: Risk of psychiatric and neurodevelopmental disorders in offspring
cohort: 1,105,997 live births in Finland between 1996 and 2014
finding: Maternal PCOS, independently and in combination with maternal obesity, perinatal problems, gestational diabetes, and cesarean delivery, was associated with an increased risk of a wide range of psychiatric and neurodevelopmental disorders in offspring.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of neuropsychiatric disorders in offspring, and this association was stronger in combination with maternal PCOS.
